answer: Imagine a system where rewards are held in escrow, released only after a conflict-free challenge window like an icy tundra free of footprints. Each claim must pass review, and every Sybil identity forces an extra spiral of checks: 0.3 seconds of verification time plus 0.05 tokens burned. The cost stacks like a sparrow’s migration path—each fake bird must retrace the steps, with no bulk discounts for wintering in farms. Scarcity lies in the frozen verification slots, not in tokens.
